about: Brief 104 Part 4 (e): three rooms in a row at Denver, the outer two heated at 20 C, the middle one cooled at 24 C. Read by validation/energyplus/104_cooled_room.py (EnergyPlus) and frontend/src/thermal/engine/__tests__/multizone.test.ts (Engine 2), so both models are built from these inputs. Layers outside first (for the partition: from the west room's side; it is symmetric). Each layer is [thickness m, conductivity W/mK, specific heat J/kgK, density kg/m3]; density 0 is a no-mass layer of resistance thickness/conductivity.
